sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:11

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:11:1
items.html: And then the illumination of the root of Hochma is drawn downward: That is to say, that the coupling was made upon the screen of phase three of the Malchut of the Rosh [head] without any sharing with the coarseness of drawing of phase four; whereupon the reflected light rising from below upward does not attain the level of the upper Keter, but only up to the level of the upper Hochma of the Rosh. And this is what he says, “and then the illumination of the root of Hochma is drawn downward” — that is, the Hochma of the Rosh, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:11:2
items.html: The male is included in the Nukva, etc., they received equally from the root of the upper Keter. This means that now that the coupling was made upon the screen of phase three, which draws only the level of Hochma of the Rosh [head], it is found that the light of Hochma of the Rosh clothed in the aspect of the vessel of Keter of the Rosh, as he goes on to explain. And since in the Rosh too the Keter and Hochma were included one in the other, it follows from this that the male, who is the record of the level of Keter, and the female, who is the aspect of the record of the level of Hochma, as above, were likewise included one in the other, and the male receives the light of the female's coupling. And this is what he says: since the male and female received equally in the first coupling from the upper Keter of the Rosh, so likewise now, after the light of Hochma came to the vessel of Keter of the Rosh, they receive from the vessel of Keter as well, both of them equally, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:11:3
items.html: The Nukva receives first of all three that are here, and they receive from her. That is to say, that at first, in the first coupling which drew the level of Keter of the Rosh [head], it is found that the light of the coupling belonged to the light of Keter that rose from the Guf [body] to the Malchut of the Rosh, and likewise to the male of the vessel of Keter, who is the record of the level of Keter; but the Nukva had no relation whatever to this light of the upper Keter, she being the record of the level of Hochma, as above. And it is found that the Nukva is the one receiving from all these three lights, on account of her inclusion in them, as above. However now, that the coupling is made upon her own aspect, that is, phase three, the Nukva is found to be the principal receiver of these three lights, for the other two have no relation to the level of Hochma, but receive from her.
